Stationary Distribution on a Recurrent Class

Source: R/05_tools.R
stat_on_class.Rd

Computes the stationary distribution associated with a recurrent communicating class and embeds it in the full state space.

Usage

stat_on_class(P, c)

Arguments

P

A StochMat object.

c

A non-empty character or integer vector containing the state names in a recurrent class.

Value

A StochVec containing the stationary probabilities. States outside the recurrent class have probability zero.

Details

The stationary probabilities within the class are computed with the Grassmann, Taksar and Heyman (1985) algorithm, using off-diagonal transition probabilities.

References

Grassmann, W. K., Taksar, M. I., and Heyman, D. P. (1985). Regenerative Analysis and Steady State Distributions for Markov Chains. Operations Research, 33(5), 1107–1116. doi:10.1287/opre.33.5.1107

Examples

P <- StochMat(matrix(c(0.8, 0.2, 0,
                       0.3, 0.7, 0,
                         0,   0, 1),
                     nrow = 3, byrow = TRUE))

stat_on_class(P, c(1L, 2L))
#> Stochastic Vector
#>   length: 3 
#>     1   2   3 
#>   0.6 0.4 0.0 
stat_on_class(P, 3L)
#> Stochastic Vector
#>   length: 3 
#>   1 2 3 
#>   0 0 1
